title: Because of / despite / in spite of
note: Preposition + NOUN, which is exactly what separates this from b1_linkers (although / however take a clause or a sentence) - b1_linkers plays immediately before, so the pair is a contrast. Traps: *despite of, *in spite the rain, and *because of it was raining. thanks to for a cause with a good result. First draft 2026-09-02, rough - thicken after smoke.

cards.title: Because of / despite / in spite of
cards.title_cz: Because of / despite / in spite of — + podstatné jméno
points: You already know **although /** however / so — those take a whole sentence.
All four of these are followed by a **noun** instead.

rows: why, and it turned out well

examples.en: We stayed in **because of** the rain.

cards.title: Noun or clause?
points: If a subject and a verb follow, you need the right-hand word.

cards.title: despite has no of
points: **despite** = **in spite** of. One has the *of*, the other does not.

cards.title: Common mistakes
points: Count the words after it: a noun, or a subject and a verb?

rows: ~~Despite of the rain, we walked home.~~
~~In spite the rain, we walked home.~~
**In spite** of the rain, we walked home.
~~Because of it was raining, we stayed in.~~
**Because** it was raining, we stayed in.
~~Thanks for your help, I finished early.~~
**Thanks to** your help, I finished early.

blocks.title: Because of / despite / in spite of · B1

items.en: We stayed in because of the rain.
items.gap: We stayed in ____ the rain. (because of / because)
accepts: We stayed in because of the rain.
items.explanation: **the rain** is a noun, so **because of**.
items.explanation_cz: **the rain** je podstatné jméno, takže **because of**.

items.en: Despite the rain, we walked home.
items.gap: ____ the rain, we walked home. (despite / despite of)
accepts: Despite the rain, we walked home.
items.wrong: Despite of the rain, we walked home.

items.en: In spite of the traffic, we arrived on time.
items.gap: ____ the traffic, we arrived on time. (in spite of / in spite)
accepts: In spite of the traffic, we arrived on time.
items.wrong: In spite the traffic, we arrived on time.

items.en: Thanks to your help, I finished early.
items.cz: Díky tvé pomoci jsem skončil brzy.
items.gap: ____ your help, I finished early. (thanks to / thanks for)
accepts: Thanks to your help, I finished early.
items.explanation: **thanks to** + noun gives a cause with a good result. *thanks for* is what you say to a person.
items.explanation_cz: **thanks to** + podstatné jméno dává příčinu s dobrým koncem. *thanks for* říkáš člověku.

items.en: Because it was raining, we stayed in.
items.gap: ____ it was raining, we stayed in. (because / because of)
accepts: Because it was raining, we stayed in.
items.wrong: Because of it was raining, we stayed in.
items.explanation: A subject and a verb follow, so plain **because**.
items.explanation_cz: Následuje podmět a sloveso, takže samotné **because**.

items.en: The match was cancelled because of the snow.
items.gap: The match was cancelled ____ the snow. (because of / because)
accepts: The match was cancelled because of the snow.
items.explanation: **the snow** is a noun: because of.
items.explanation_cz: **the snow** je podstatné jméno: because of.

items.en: Despite his age, he still works full time.
items.cz: Navzdory svému věku pořád pracuje na plný úvazek.
items.gap: ____ his age, he still works full time. (despite / although)
accepts: Despite his age, he still works full time.
items.explanation: **his age** is a noun, so despite. *although* would need a clause.
items.explanation_cz: **his age** je podstatné jméno, takže despite. *although* by potřebovalo větu.

items.en: Although it was cold, we sat outside.
items.cz: I když byla zima, seděli jsme venku.
items.gap: ____ it was cold, we sat outside. (although / despite)
accepts: Although it was cold, we sat outside.
items.explanation: A subject and a verb follow, so **although**, not despite.
items.explanation_cz: Následuje podmět a sloveso, takže **although**, ne despite.

items.en: Thanks to the new road, the journey is shorter.
items.cz: Díky nové silnici je cesta kratší.
items.gap: ____ the new road, the journey is shorter. (thanks to / because)
accepts: Thanks to the new road, the journey is shorter.
items.explanation: A cause with a good result: **thanks to** + noun.
items.explanation_cz: Příčina s dobrým koncem: **thanks to** + podstatné jméno.

items.en: In spite of the noise, I slept well.
items.cz: Navzdory hluku jsem se dobře vyspal.
items.gap: ____ the noise, I slept well. (in spite of / despite of)
accepts: In spite of the noise, I slept well.
items.explanation: **in spite of** is the three-word form. *despite of* does not exist.
items.explanation_cz: **in spite of** je tříslovný tvar. *despite of* neexistuje.
